name: Word Grid Challenge Bot
description: Telegram Word Grid Challenge game bot with leaderboards and Ludo Mini App

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram User ID (message @userinfobot to get it)

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Telegram Group ID for bot logs (optional)

SUPPORT_CHANNEL.description: Your support channel link e.g. https://t.me/yourchannel

LUDO_WEB_APP_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of the Ludo Mini App (e.g. https://yourapp.onrender.com/ludo)

WEBAPP_SECRET_KEY.description: Flask secret key for session signing (random string)
